{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Altus sopor''''' was the traditional term for the [[Force power/Legends|ability]] to increase a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|user's]] focus on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. ''Altus sopor'' was a basic component of the control area of Force techniques, and when developed, could allow a practitioner to [[Force stealth|merge into the Force]] so that they would become [[Force cloak|invisible]] to others even to those with the most acute senses. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] guidebook [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force|''The Jedi Path'']] described the technique.
